findings.title: Open redirect: unvalidated `redirectTo` now reachable via /staff/login
findings.detail: Pre-existing: `searchParams.get('redirectTo') ?? '/'` goes straight into `router.replace(redirectURL)` at line 136, so after sign-in `/staff/login?redirectTo=https://evil.example` sends the user off-site. The new page (page.tsx:30) renders the same view, giving staff a second entry point. Fix belongs in a unit that owns Login.tsx (this unit's Hard rules forbid editing it): accept only same-origin relative paths starting with `/`, not `//`, no scheme; fall back to `/`.

findings.title: Test imports `render`/`screen` directly from `@testing-library/react` instead of the house harness
findings.detail: Every other test in the repo (src/test/smoke.test.tsx:3, PatientShell/index.test.tsx:15, ReceptionBoard/index.test.tsx:22) imports render/screen (or renderWithProviders) from `@/test/utils`, per CLAUDE.md's harness description. Change to `import { render, screen } from '@/test/utils'`.
